description: This is a test suite for the ChatUI React component, covering rendering, interaction with endpoint selectors, model selection, and conditional UI elements in a chat application.

methods.name: should render the chat UI
methods.description: Tests that the ChatUI component renders correctly with initial props.

methods.name: should show the voice selector when the endpoint type is audio_speech
methods.description: Simulates selecting the audio speech endpoint and verifies the voice selector appears.

methods.name: should allow the user to select a model
methods.description: Opens the model selection dropdown and verifies that models are selectable.

methods.name: shows only chat-compatible models when chat endpoint is selected
methods.description: Tests filtering of models based on the selected endpoint, ensuring only chat-compatible models are shown.

methods.name: should show 'Enter custom model' option in model selector
methods.description: Ensures the dropdown includes an option for manually entering a model.
